notes.title: Final update. End of the development.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37890351/842c758bbba9c82168ef54ce66da9dbe2dec22b9.jpg[/img]
Dear friends, we inform you that the development of the visual novel "My Silly Life" is over!

The game has been updated.
Thank you for being with us!
The number of text characters increased by 8 times! 25 new backgrounds were created. The game also has about 10 new music tracks.
Small patches may be released in the near future to correct the English translation.
We apologize for the long days of waiting and hope that the final product will give you only positive emotions.

Enjoy the game!
Best wishes from the storkyproduct. team.

notes.title: Last steps
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37890351/305a065aadd9a725d8e187aea6089e4c55539c13.jpg[/img]Dear friends! 
We need to inform you that the work on the script is over! 
As a result, the number of words has been increased 8 times! 
We are currently working on the technical component of the game! Soon you will be able to enjoy a full-fledged product! It is also worth noting that the development team has grown, which has a positive impact on the quality of the project! 
We are sorry for the wait! 
Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: The demo version of the game is ready!
notes.notes:
[h1]The first demo for curators is already available![/h1]
The demo version of the game will show graphics and first game staps to the curators. 
I am still working on the game to make it as interesting and beautiful as possible.
The estimated release date for the game is August 2020.
[h1]Future of Demo-version[/h1]
The existing demo version is quite short, but most likely I will not be able to update it.
The main reason is the lack of time because I develop the whole game alone. Work on the demo version takes too much time, which I now lack.
Thank you for understanding!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37890351/4b951c33e149b2433d5944ba45acd767e57bb91c.png[/img]

notes.title: New interface. The first demo for curators.
notes.notes:
[h1]Interface[/h1]
At the moment, work has been completed on the new design of the game interface, the menu will be ready a little later.
[h1]Launch Issues[/h1]
I am aware of the problem with the launch of the game by the curators, I will upload the first short demo-version next week. I'm not yet ready to provide a version for an hour or more, the demo will only demonstrate the first steps of the game and the overall design.
Thank you for your patience!
